app.title: Open-source 3D anatomy explorer: 2,234 selectable BodyParts3D meshes
app.author: metrofun
app.description: A 3D anatomy explorer web application that loads and renders over two thousand selectable human body part meshes.
proposed_tests: Clone repository and run npm install
Serve the app locally and ensure the index page loads without errors
Load a random BodyParts3D mesh and verify that the 3D model renders in the viewer
Run the automated tests (if any) to confirm interactive features work
